mapper.select: SELECT id, order_id, order_no, product_id, sku_id, product_name, sku_name, sku_attrs, product_cover, price, quantity, total_amount, pv_value, total_pv, cost_amount, total_cost, create_time FROM dms_shop_order_item WHERE order_id = #{orderId} ORDER BY id ASC
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO dms_shop_order_item (order_id, order_no, product_id, sku_id, product_name, sku_name, sku_attrs, product_cover, price, quantity, total_amount, pv_value, total_pv, cost_amount, total_cost) VALUES (#{orderId}, #{orderNo}, #{productId}, #{skuId}, #{productName}, #{skuName}, #{skuAttrs}, #{productCover}, #{price}, #{quantity}, #{totalAmount}, #{pvValue}, #{totalPv}, #{costAmount}, #{totalCost})
